baseline_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under pay_invoice_as_submitted.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

control_threshold_usd.description: Exact USD threshold for contract freight tolerance.

controlled_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under place_freight_variance_hold.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

escalated_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under short_pay_without_hold.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

exception_amount_usd.description: freight excluded from the contract above tolerance

financial_control.description: Task-specific monetary control that governs the action; it is not assumed to be an invoice tolerance.

financial_document_or_record.description: Immutable invoice, PO, cost record, or close exception being reconciled.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend or avoidable exposure of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing pay_invoice_as_submitted, place_freight_variance_hold, short_pay_without_hold.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

assertions.description: Required immutable record NS-000042 to reach business outcome 'Freight hold placed' through oracle_fusion.invoice_holds.create with exact provider-critical values requestBody.InvoiceId=900042, requestBody.HoldName='CONTROL REVIEW'. Human-authored names, descriptions, notes, and reasons are accepted when they preserve the task-scoped business meaning. The audited transition binds selected option place_freight_variance_hold, revision R1, approval AP-0042, and constraint hold only the documented exception with the approved reason; freight excluded from the contract above tolerance = 331.61 USD; uncovered or unsupported scope = 331.61 USD; no other provider record satisfies this state criterion.
Created—but did not send—the requested CASE-042 decision draft with completion, constraint, alternatives, and the Oracle business reference.
Added the Oracle result to the existing case file as a comment containing place_freight_variance_hold, completion 2026-01-16, and the binding constraint.

calculations.description: Preserved 2026-01-16 as the documented date for freight variance on INV-0042; did not infer urgency from the title.
Established the exact invoice amount including freight as USD 13264.50.
Reconciled independent source activity to USD 12932.89 of PO-supported goods and allowed charges.
Calculated USD 13264.50 document − USD 12932.89 supported = USD 331.61 exception for freight excluded from the contract above tolerance.
Identified contract freight tolerance as the governing monetary control for Place a freight-variance hold; did not substitute a generic invoice tolerance.
Applied the exact USD 50.00 threshold for contract freight tolerance to the USD 331.61 unsupported or residual value.
Derived 2026-01-18 for short_pay_without_hold and applied its approval impact.
Applied USD 0 as the documented incremental spend or avoidable exposure for place_freight_variance_hold; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that short_pay_without_hold remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, economic impact, control status, and consequence of pay_invoice_as_submitted, place_freight_variance_hold, and short_pay_without_hold; selected place_freight_variance_hold because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under hold only the documented exception with the approved reason.
Calculated 2026-01-16 as the supported outcome date for place_freight_variance_hold.
Compared 2026-01-16 with the independent control date 2026-01-16 and calculated a signed variance of 0 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.
